title: Inventory whole Brig boundary and reusable original tests

acceptance_criteria.description: Map complete configured Brig API/state/security/operations boundary.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Source-cited public/internal/federation/account/auth/client/prekey/MLS/connection/OAuth/provider/calling/team contracts, peers/queue/search/schema/config/lifecycle and inherited concerns; finite acceptance and rollback gaps identified.

acceptance_criteria.description: Identify reusable original compiled and source tests with finite harness needs.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Actual pinned nonroot network-none Docker original list/help and binary identities; source/compiled variants mapped, unavailable native checks explicit, concrete original baseline/selection/gap requirements established without claiming unrun passes.

handoff: Brig inventory claimed; read actual source and discover original compiled tests before freezing finite contract/harness requirements.
